decisions.reason: Although it is a core cardboard display and earlier investment favored persistence, two years without visible market presence mean the public commitment has faded and management would likely now discontinue it.

Its close fit with the established range would once have encouraged staying the course, but after prolonged non-observation the firm would likely stop backing this specific variant as a distinct product.

This standard quarter-pallet format is central enough to have benefited from escalation of commitment, yet by 2022 the lack of continued presentation suggests it would be absorbed back into the general offer rather than kept as a separate product.
The eighth-pallet display is still near the core business, but after two years off the visible portfolio management would probably end the dedicated product rather than keep justifying it.

Because the wooden pallet is less central than the cardboard display line and has not been visibly maintained, the firm would be most likely to release resources from it despite earlier launch commitments.
Its narrower media-specific application and the disappearance of visible support reduce the scope for continued escalation, so management would likely withdraw it within the coming year.
